# TrueSignal

> TrueSignal is a native iOS and Android app that measures your actual
> network connection quality with active ping monitoring — not the signal
> bars your phone shows. It records witnessed, timestamped sessions and
> exports defensible PDF evidence reports for ISP disputes. No GPS, no
> account, no analytics, no tracking, no ads. Free to try; Pro is
> $5.99/month, $29.99/year, or $59.99 lifetime (all tiers include every
> Pro feature).

## About

- [Homepage](https://truesignal.live): What TrueSignal does, features, screenshots, and pricing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://truesignal.live/privacy/): No location, no accounts, no analytics — all data stays on your device. Full policy.

## Key features

- Active ping-based latency monitoring with plain-English diagnosis ("Connection is slow. Latency is very high.")
- Capture Sessions: a witnessed recording of connection quality over 1–60 minutes with locked methodology (2s ping rate, 6s buckets) and visible gap documentation, exported as a defensible PDF.
- ISP Evidence Pack: a formal PDF with executive summary, full timestamped event timeline, and ISP talking points.
- Network baselines that learn what is normal per-network and flag deviations.
- Unified Timeline of every outage, brownout, network switch, and bookmark in one feed.
- One-tap Diagnose: six checks (device, router, internet, DNS, captive portal, ping target) in about 5 seconds.

## Blog

- [TrueSignal Blog](https://truesignal.live/blog/): Founder writing on why signal bars lie, how Capture Sessions works, and the privacy-first design decisions behind the app.

## Positioning

- TrueSignal answers "what has my connection been doing over time?" — not the one-shot "how fast is it right now?" of a speed test.
- Built for people in ISP disputes who need proof, remote workers whose calls freeze mid-meeting, and field professionals who need reliable uploads on the go.
- The privacy stance (no GPS, no account, no tracking) is a deliberate design choice, not an afterthought.
